claims.claim: Selected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Photo 0 spines show five of six titles are marketing/sales focused (This Is Marketing, Sell Like Crazy, Crushing It!, Guerrilla Marketing, Sell or Be Sold); Rich Dad Poor Dad is personal finance rather than marketing/sales, a minor mismatch.

risks.risk: Books could be unauthorized photocopies or pirated reprints rather than originals (common in this market)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of ISBN barcode, copyright page, and print quality/paper texture for each book
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/possible reprint, i.e. low-end used price

risks.risk: Cover, spine, and page condition (creases, stains, highlighting, torn pages) not visible from a flat spine-on stack shot
risks.proof: Individual photos of front/back covers and a flip-through video showing random interior pages

risks.risk: Set completeness and whether any book is missing pages or has a damaged binding
risks.proof: Video showing each book opened fully front to back
risks.if_unproven: priced as if one book may be defective

risks.risk: Actual edition/printing (first edition vs later, collector value differences)
risks.proof: Photo of copyright/edition page for each title
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/no special edition premium

proof_requests: Clear individual photos of each book's front cover, back cover, and spine
Close-up of ISBN/barcode and copyright page for each book
Short video flipping through pages of each book to show condition and completeness
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies six marketing/sales/business paperbacks, so a worst-case price (assuming possible reprint status and used wear) can be set pending condition and authenticity proof.
